title: Barcelona Walking Tour
text: Spectacular sights Well informed and passionate guide. Sagrada Família very incredible sight. Perfect length of time
author: Dan_S

title: Sagrada Familia Dream
text: Visiting the Sagrada Familia, one of my dreams...unlocked! and if it is by the hand of a guide like Xavi, even better. We spent a really fabulous morning, thank you!
author: Jet39836945294

title: Great experience!
text: Simply great! This half day tour is the first thing you should do to understand a city as complex as Barcelona. Our guide was Adriano, a local guy full of knowledge and eager to show you his city.
author: soniaaO3492FH

title: An essential tour
text: The best tour you can take in Barcelona. It is a very big city with a lot to see, but without a doubt, this tour is essential. Our guide was Marc, a true genius
author: kimberlyhT664JG

title: Barcelona half day tour
text: I can't give this tour 6 stars.... but I would! Our guide was Adriano, and he made the morning fly by. The Sagrada Familia was crowded, but we got the best spots, and being a private tour, there were no long lines or rushing. I think this is the best way to get to know Barcelona.
author: pacoh998

title: Sagrada Familia
text: If you have little time in Barcelona, this is the tour for you. I went to Barcelona for a stopover to continue my trip to Granada. I only had one day, so I had to take advantage of it, and so I did. Our guide was Xavi, one of the best guides I have ever had. Without a doubt, highly recommended.
author: eduardodF542RM
